name: Drugaya Istoriya
source:
Upon returning from Sovyonok, Semyon cannot bear the weight of losing Lena and attempts suicide.
However, by a miracle, his future self manages to save him from blood loss and drag him to the hospital.
Semyon is offered a chance to change the ending for his beloved and to rescue everyone else from the camp's captivity.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=506113843]Steam[/url]]
